description.narrative: Brookfield RJ is a group of special purpose vehicles (SPVs) (collectively the Borrower(s)) developing ~560 MWp portfolio of ground mounted open access (OA) solar plants in Bikaner, Rajasthan supplying power to commercial and industrial (C&I) clients through a long-term power purchase agreement (PPA) and sale of power on energy exchanges. The SPVs are wholly owned by BGTF Holdings (DIFC) Limited, which are ultimately owned by Brookfield Corporation (Brookfield). The proposed investment consists of senior debt financing of up to US$95 million in INR equivalent to finance the development of solar plant.

The investment is expected to increase domestic renewable energy capacity resulting in positive environmental effects through GHG emission reduction, contributing to Indias decarbonization efforts, and meeting growing energy demand from C&I customers, at potentially competitive tariffs. Beyond the Project, the investment is expected to increase competitiveness by demonstrating the viability of renewable distributed generation to the C&I segment through innovative PPA constructs, and open access interstate transmission.
